# HAPI v0.29.0.6 (maintained build)

Upstream-first rebuild from official `upstream/main` at `980a921ba15665c54998a6ddb658103d467ff4cb` with 160 current open PRs audited: 58 carry, 98 defer, 4 drop.

## Compared with the previous maintained release

Compared with `v0.29.0.5`:

- #1771 replaces HAPI-owned prompt injection with the bundled native `hapi-session-runtime` skill and deterministic JSON CLI commands. Fresh spawn and initial remit delivery are atomic; retries retain correlation IDs, interrupted operations reconcile, and stop/archive/delete have distinct lifecycle semantics. Peer commands now require exact session IDs. User-authored custom prompts remain supported.
- #1607 fixes atomic group deletion when cascading child rows inflate SQLite change counts.
- #1766 preserves the visible message prefix while rewind refreshes the latest window, retaining the maintained fork fallback and scroll-boundary behavior.
- #1770 centers the inactive-session notice text.
- #1773 adds a confirmed current-device mark-all-read action, including deduplicated source rows while excluding empty hidden stubs.
- Include bundled skill files in Runner artifact fingerprints so skill-only updates cannot reuse stale binaries.
- Install the bundled skill as `hapi-session-runtime` so existing user/Skillshare `hapi-session-control` symlinks remain untouched and cannot block new sessions.
- Preserve Runner artifact generations and workspace access, stream IDs, title-provider controls, and existing maintained security boundaries. The old HAPI summary-emission prompt setting is superseded by #1771; summary display and stored messages remain available.

## Compared with the official release

Compared with official `v0.29.0`, includes the maintained desktop, fleet upgrades, imports, model-error handling, scratchlist, schema V29, and protocol V2 overlay plus the audited changes above.

#1753 remains deferred because its latest bot review reports that a fresh cached catalog can reject valid models after a Cursor executable upgrade. #1693 and #1772 await official acceptance of their broader fullscreen/export and filter UX scope. #1774's vendor recommendation awaits editorial acceptance. Existing explicit drops remain in effect; #1320 is not replayed.

## Personal PR policy exceptions

Personal carries are included under the existing operator policy. #1771 spans 151 files and 4926 additions; its latest-head review is clean, but the cross-runtime integration requires full release gates. #1468 has a failing current mechanical check; the maintained implementation remains subject to this release's complete tests. Rehearsal exceptions retained from the prior policy: #1662 and #1436 `maintainer-policy-exception`; #1468 `status-checks-failed, maintainer-policy-exception`. All are tested in the resolved release tree.

## Distribution

Standalone four-part maintenance release, with signed macOS CLI archives, Linux and Windows CLI archives, Windows/macOS desktop bundles, and `checksums.txt`. Optional platform packages remain on official `0.29.0`. The implicit standalone upgrade channel remains off; Windows uses the explicit verified hub-artifact rollout.

- Preserve the sidebar viewport across background pin and activity updates (#1776), including collapsed projects.

PR #1424 is temporarily excluded at the operator’s request: stale running jobs can keep inactive sessions pinned. Session job commands, API, meters, and Jobs pinning are removed; normal active-session pinning remains. Existing schema V29 and stored legacy job rows are preserved without powering UI or deletion guards.
